defs.d: (money) A subunit of currency equal to one-hundredth of the main unit of currency in many countries. Symbol: ¢.
A small sum of money.
defs.ex: He blew every last cent.

defs.d: The point in the interior of a circle that is equidistant from all points on the circumference.
The point in the interior of a sphere that is equidistant from all points on the circumference.
A centigrade temperature scale having the freezing point of water defined as 0° and its boiling point defined as 100° at standard atmospheric pressure. Known as the Celsius scale since 1948.
A single degree on this scale.
defs.ex: a temperature of 34 centigrades

defs.d: A kind of needle, shorter than a sharp, with a small rounded eye, used for making fine stitches on heavy fabrics.
In the position or interval that separates (two things), or intermediate in quantity or degree. (See Usage notes below.)
defs.ex: I want to buy one that costs somewhere between forty and fifty dollars.

defs.d: Done together or reciprocally.
defs.ex: conversation between friends

defs.d: Any person; anybody.
defs.ex: Almost anyone can change a light bulb.

defs.d: A container, typically made of glass or plastic and having a tapered neck, used primarily for holding liquids.
defs.ex: Beer is often sold in bottles.

defs.d: The contents of such a container.
defs.ex: I only drank a bottle of beer.

defs.d: To seal (a liquid) into a bottle for later consumption. Also fig.
defs.ex: This plant bottles vast quantities of spring water every day.

defs.d: To feed (an infant) baby formula.
defs.ex: Because of complications she can't breast feed her baby and so she bottles him.

defs.d: A young male.
defs.ex: Kate is dating a boy named Jim.

defs.d: (diminutive) A male child: a son of any age.
To use the word “boy” to refer to someone.
defs.ex: Don't boy me!

defs.d: To act as a boy (in allusion to the former practice of boys acting women's parts on the stage).
Exclamation of surprise, pleasure or longing.
defs.ex: Boy, I wish I could go to Canada!

defs.d: A motor vehicle for transporting large numbers of people along roads.
An electrical conductor or interface serving as a common connection for two or more circuits or components.
To transport via a motor bus.
To transport students to school, often to a more distant school for the purposes of achieving racial integration.
A flexible container made of cloth, paper, plastic, etc.
A handbag
To put into a bag.
To catch or kill, especially when fishing or hunting.
defs.ex: We bagged three deer yesterday.

defs.d: (often in the plural) In general, a product of plant growth useful to man or animals.

Specifically, a sweet, edible part of a plant that resembles seed-bearing fruit (see next sense), even if it does not develop from a floral ovary; also used in a technically imprecise sense for some sweet or sweetish vegetables, such as the petioles of rhubarb, that resemble a true fruit or are used in cookery as if they were a fruit.
To produce fruit, seeds, or spores.
A cold-blooded vertebrate animal that lives in water, moving with the help of fins and breathing with gills.
defs.ex: Salmon is a fish.

defs.d: Any animal (or any vertebrate) that lives exclusively in water.
A day on which a festival, religious event, or national celebration is traditionally observed.
defs.ex: Today is a Wiccan holiday!

defs.d: A day declared free from work by the state or government.
To take a period of time away from work or study.
To spend a period of time for travel.
A discrete division of something.
A sharp extremity.
An article of clothing that is worn on the upper part of the body, and often has sleeves, either long or short, that cover the arms.
defs.ex: It can take a while to learn how to iron a shirt properly.

defs.d: An interior lining in a blast furnace.
Sick people in general as a group.
defs.ex: We have to cure the sick.

defs.d: Vomit.
defs.ex: He lay there in a pool of his own sick.

defs.d: To vomit.
defs.ex: I woke up at 4 am and sicked on the floor.

defs.d: To fall sick; to sicken.
Having an urge to vomit.
In poor health.
defs.ex: She was sick all day with the flu.

defs.d: Condensed water falling from a cloud.
defs.ex: The rains came late that year.

defs.d: Any matter moving or falling, usually through air, and especially if liquid or otherwise figuratively identifiable with raindrops.
To have rain fall from the sky.
defs.ex: It will rain today.

defs.d: To fall as or like rain.
defs.ex: Bombs rained from the sky.

defs.d: Money given in return for work; salary or wages.
defs.ex: Many employers have rules designed to keep employees from comparing their pays.

defs.d: To give money or other compensation to in exchange for goods or services.
defs.ex: he paid her off the books and in kind where possible

defs.d: To discharge, as a debt or other obligation, by giving or doing what is due or required.
defs.ex: he has paid his debt to society

defs.d: Operable or accessible on deposit of coins.
defs.ex: pay toilet

defs.d: Pertaining to or requiring payment.
The assessed value of an asset from which the tax owing is computed.
An electronic communication medium that allows the transmission of real-time visual images, and often sound.
defs.ex: It’s a good thing that television doesn’t transmit smell.

defs.d: A device for receiving television signals and displaying them in visual form.
defs.ex: I have an old television in the study.

defs.d: The amount of air breathed in or out during normal respiration.
(of an object) To join (to another object): to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to another object.
defs.ex: I think this piece connects to that piece over there.

defs.d: (of two objects) To join: to attach, or to be intended to attach or capable of attaching, to each other.
defs.ex: Both roads have the same name, but they don't connect: they're on opposite sides of the river, and there's no bridge there.

defs.d: Something given to another voluntarily, without charge.
A talent or natural ability.
defs.ex: She had a gift for playing the flute.

defs.d: To give as a gift or donation.
To give away, to concede easily.
One of the female (feminine) sex or gender.
Belonging to the sex which typically produces eggs (ova), or to the gender which is typically associated with it.
defs.ex: female authors, the leading male and female artists, a female bird cooing at a male, intersex female patients, a trans female vlogger

defs.d: Characteristic of this sex/gender. (Compare feminine, womanly.)
defs.ex: stereotypically female pastimes, an insect with typically female coloration

defs.d: Without humor or expression of happiness; grave in manner or disposition
defs.ex: It was a surprise to see the captain, who had always seemed so serious, laugh so heartily.

defs.d: Important; weighty; not insignificant
defs.ex: This is a serious problem. We'll need our best experts.

defs.d: In a serious manner; seriously.
That which is taken from another; something captured; a thing seized by force, stratagem, or superior power.
Anything captured by a belligerent using the rights of war; especially, property captured at sea in virtue of the rights of war, as a vessel.
The amount of money levied for a service.
defs.ex: There will be a charge of five dollars.

defs.d: A ground attack against a prepared enemy.
defs.ex: Pickett did not die leading his famous charge.

defs.d: To assign a duty or responsibility to
To assign (a debit) to an account
defs.ex: Let's charge this to marketing.

defs.d: Entertainment; pleasure.
Reception of a guest; welcome.
To amuse (someone); to engage the attention of agreeably.
defs.ex: The motivational speaker not only instructed but also entertained the audience.

defs.d: To have someone over at one's home for a party or visit.
defs.ex: They enjoy entertaining a lot.

defs.d: A scarce or uncommon item.
Very uncommon; scarce.
defs.ex: Black pearls are very rare and therefore very valuable.

defs.d: (of a gas) Thin; of low density.
Nuclear power
Pertaining to the nucleus of an atom.
Involving energy released by nuclear reactions (fission, fusion, radioactive decay).
defs.ex: a nuclear reactor

defs.d: A person in the business of navigating ships or other vessels
Someone knowledgeable in the practical management of ships.
defs.ex: He's a talented sailor and has spent many years at sea.

defs.d: Flexible material in a roll with a sticky surface on one or both sides; adhesive tape.
defs.ex: Hand me some tape. I need to fix a tear in this paper.

defs.d: Thin and flat paper, plastic or similar flexible material, usually produced in the form of a roll.
defs.ex: After the party there was tape all over the place.

defs.d: To bind with adhesive tape.
defs.ex: Be sure to tape your parcel securely before posting it.

defs.d: To record, particularly onto magnetic tape.
defs.ex: You shouldn’t have said that. The microphone was on and we were taping.

defs.d: (in the plural) Objects or facts that are coexistent, or in agreement with one another.
A kind of penitent who was allowed to assist at prayers, but was not permitted to receive the holy sacraments.
Of a regularly occurring, dependable nature.
defs.ex: He is very consistent in his political choices: economy good or bad, he always votes Labour!

defs.d: Compatible, accordant.
To get.
To gain, usually by one's own exertions; to get as one's own
defs.ex: He acquired a title.

defs.d: To make suitable; to make to correspond; to fit or suit
To fit by alteration; to modify or remodel for a different purpose; to adjust
defs.ex: to adapt a story for the stage

defs.d: Adapted; fit; suited; suitable.
An act or instance of lending, an act or instance of granting something for temporary use.
defs.ex: Because of the loan that John made to me, I was able to pay my tuition for the upcoming semester.

defs.d: A sum of money or other property that a natural or legal person borrows from another with the condition that it be returned or repaid over time or at a later date (sometimes with interest).
defs.ex: All loans from the library, whether books or audio material, must be returned within two weeks.

defs.d: To lend (something) to (someone).
A view, vista or outlook.
The appearance of depth in objects, especially as perceived using binocular vision.
Of, in or relating to perspective.
defs.ex: a perspective drawing

defs.d: Providing visual aid; of or relating to the science of vision; optical.
A mass of things heaped together; a heap.
A group or list of related items up for consideration, especially in some kind of selection process.
defs.ex: When we were looking for a new housemate, we put the nice woman on the "maybe" pile, and the annoying guy on the "no" pile

defs.d: (often used with the preposition "up") To lay or throw into a pile or heap; to heap up; to collect into a mass; to accumulate
defs.ex: They were piling up wood on the wheelbarrow.

defs.d: To cover with heaps; or in great abundance; to fill or overfill; to load.
defs.ex: We piled the camel with our loads.
